cage_install._margin_note: 23% gross margin = 20% target margin + 3.5% credit card fee buffer. Math: net after card fee = sell × 0.965; want net margin 20% → sell = cost/(0.80×0.965) = cost/0.772 → 22.8% gross → round to 23%.
cage_install._note: Day-based install pricing benchmarked against assemblyandrepair.com, lfssportsnetting.com, battingcagesinc.com. Concrete-set HD frames add 1 day of labor.

putting_green_upcharge.label: Putting green specialty labor (cup-cutter rent, base detail, fringe seam)
putting_green_upcharge._note: Reduced from $3 since hardware is now itemized below

shock_pad.label: Shock pad 8mm (fall-rated)
shock_pad._note: Required for Playground (fall-height rating); optional upsell for Pet Turf

plant_install._note: Plant pricing model: each plant's material cost is billed at 2× wholesale (markup_multiplier). Per-pot install labor is added on top, ranging $40–$80 by size. A warranty + delivery reserve of 5% of plant material is added as a separate line covering 60-day replacement and load/dispatch. Standard project margin_pct wraps the whole basis after those line items, same as turf/Cimarron/etc.
plant_install._labor_note: Per-plant install labor $40–$80 range covers dig, amend, set, backfill, water-in for container plants up to 65g. Anything 100g+, B&B, or Box requires machinery + multi-person crew (and often a 2nd visit for staking) — labor table returns 0 for these sizes; quote them as a custom line per job.
plant_install._material_note: size_tier 'material' = bagged/bulk landscape goods from the nursery catalog — no dig-and-plant labor; sold as material only.

rock_install._note: Rock + stone material from supplier catalogs (e.g. Clear Fork Materials). Each rock's wholesale cost is billed at 1.75× (markup_multiplier) — slightly lower than plants because rock is heavier, less spoilage, and customer expectations for stone-yard markup are tighter than nursery markup. Per-unit spread labor is added separately ($60/ton for hand-spread decorative rock). A 5% delivery + breakage reserve is added on top of marked-up material. Standard project margin_pct wraps the basis like every other component.
rock_install._labor_note: Spread labor benchmarks vary by unit. Ton is the standard for decorative rock; yard for bulk soil/mulch; piece for slab/coping. Heavy slabs, hand-set coping, and dry-stack walls need a custom labor quote — defaults below are a baseline.

tree_removal._note: Subcontracted tree/stump removal. Enter sub cost; project margin applies on top (no extra multiplier). At 30% margin a $1,000 sub bill sells for ~$1,430.
tree_removal.label: Tree & stump removal (subcontracted)

settings._shape_note: Turf waste allowance by yard shape when no usable dims are given. Single source of truth — the internal builder and partner portal both read this.
settings._floors_note: Tiered floors and benchmarks calibrated from 82 closed-won estimates ($458k revenue). Floor = warn-below; benchmark = median realized $/SF for that size bucket.
settings._note: Defaults calibrated from 2026 YTD P&L: 24 jobs, avg margin 27.06%, 'other' costs ~9.3% of revenue (~10% of direct cost)
